display.name: Big Shoulders Display (Google Fonts name: Big Shoulders)
display.note: The file is the Black (900) static instance at the 72pt optical size. The website uses the variable font with the optical-size axis.
display.use: Names, big numerals, headings, huge closing phrases. Condensed, sporty, stadium-sign energy.

body.name: Geist
body.note: File is the Medium (500) weight; the website uses the variable font.
body.use: Running text and interface copy. Neutral, clean.

mono.name: Geist Mono
mono.use: Small labels and captions: places, years, URLs, stats captions. A nod to the engineering background.

licenses: All three are SIL Open Font License 1.1. License texts are next to the font files (fonts/OFL-*.txt).

scale.note: Display text is deliberately huge and confident. On the site it is clamp()ed between about 5rem and 22rem; headings split over two lines.
scale.label: 0.75rem

patterns: Two-line split display heading: first line flush left, second line indented about 0.4-0.6em (CAIO / BATISTA, ON / CODE, OFF / CODE).
Outlined numerals: display type with a transparent fill and a 1.5px ink stroke; they fill solid on emphasis (used for the year on the timeline).
Bold key words inside body copy with an amber band under them (a highlighter), amber used as a fill, never as text colour on light.
Mono caps captions with wide tracking carry the small facts (PORTO ALEGRE, 2026).
